fire: The old king spake unto his sons and bade them depart.
Verily I say unto you, the harvest is plenteous.
Woe unto him that hath no mercy for the poor.
Wherefore art thou weeping, asked the shepherd.
As the psalm says, the Lord giveth and the Lord taketh away.
Knowest thou not that the night cometh soon?
Honour thy father and thy mother all thy days.
Let him that hath ears to hear listen to these words.
